MHM2

Accelerate Bench task · Bioinformatics & phylogenetics

MHM2 coassembles a metagenome from paired sequencing reads of a synthetic community.

Task version1.1.1CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The supplied paired reads pass through contigging and scaffolding rounds, followed by read alignment and abundance estimation.

Correctness

The verifier checks sequence content, checkpoint contigs, graph connectivity, read alignments and abundance outputs.

Timing

The entire coassembly driver is timed. Input generation and output checks run separately.

Reported runtime-saving reward

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
